Grade: Grade 3

Strand: Caring for the 3.2 Caring for Animals By the end of the sub-strand,  In groups,
Topic 3.3: Managing waste environment

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Managing waste environment
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Managing waste environment
2. give Kenyan examples of Managing waste environment
3. practise a safe skill for Managing waste environment

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Managing waste environment

Teach
• Observe Managing waste environment in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Managing waste environment (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Managing waste environment.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Managing waste environment.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Managing waste environment.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Managing waste environment.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Managing waste environment: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Managing waste environment with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.
